newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia PGM group Almaz confirms officials in Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Russia PGM group Almaz confirms officials in Tokyo.

text.p: Officials from Russia's platinum group metal export agent Almazjuvelirexport (Almaz) are in Tokyo for talks with Japanese clients, an Almaz source said on Monday.

"Yes, Vitaly Berlin and Andrei Travkin are in Tokyo, and yes, they are there to discuss platinum and palladium exports," the source said, responding to news from Tokyo that the two Almaz officials had arrived on Sunday.
The Almaz source could not comment further on the talks.
Russia is the world's largest palladium and second largest platinum supplier, and Japan the largest consumer of both.
But Russia has not exported any platinum group metals in 1997, with officials in Moscow citing bureaucratic problems and earlier delays passing the federal budget as the main reasons for the hold-up.
Palladium prices have surged to 17-year highs on the absence of Russian exports.
